data.title: Community Spotlight: November 2023
data.summary: Check out what went down in November
data.content:
November may have been chilly, but War Robots: Frontiers was on fire. Check out what happened in November and what’s to come in December!

Developer Q&A (November 24)

Creative Director Zukata and Executive Producer Nausicaa answered your questions on November 24, and it was a lot of fun! Thanks to everyone who came and played, and for all the suggestions and feedback. We look forward to the next Q&A in the new year. 

Community Content 

We love seeing how creative our Pilots are, and we want to shine a light on some of the best from November! Green Man behind the walls blew us away with their first post on Discord and this awesome Ravana artwork. We look forward to seeing more!

Development Insights

We regularly share some of the concepts and tweaks we are working on via our Discord to give 

players a sneak peek into the development process. Here are a few of the things we shared in November:

Improved Robot Animations

We are continually improving our Robots’ walking, running, and landing animations. When accelerating and braking, Robots lean forward or backward, and when turning, they can tilt accordingly.

Ravana Wallpaper

We couldn't help but share this stunning art featuring Ravana. Feel free to use it for your content or wallpapers!

Introducing the Updated Mont

Before the Autumn update, we shared a walkaround of the new Mont Map, showing off the main changes, its icy landscape, increased destructibility, and an overall improved sense of scale.

Robot Colour Schemes

We noticed a few comments on Ravana’s color scheme and wanted to share our take on the original. Let us know if you would like to see more unique color schemes on future Robots or if you’d prefer we retain more of the original design.

December Community Events

Join us for festive fun this December, and participate in the Warlords of Winter Event from December 11-31. Earn Honor alongside your fellow Pilots to obtain cool rewards.

Login daily to earn Bulwark Robot Parts from December 18-24, and build a bot to surpass all others.

Keep an eye on our social media channels throughout the holiday season for promo codes!

Every Friday throughout December: Community Play Sessions

Remember to join our weekly Discord Community Play Sessions held on Discord at 17:00 UTC every Friday (times may vary). Drop in, say hi, and ask some questions!

We’ll be taking a break for the holidays, so no Community Play Session is scheduled for December 29. We’ll be back to normal in January, so enjoy the holiday season!
 

Be sure to join our Discord to see all of these updates first. Thanks for playing, Pilots!
